Thanks, this checks out: `claude-opus-4-8` is the replacement Anthropic's deprecations page names for Opus 3, `gemini-3.6-flash` is live, and dropping `temperature=0.7` is correct since Claude 4.7 and later return a 400 for a non-default temperature.

Two small things before merge:
1. Google deprecated `gemini-3.5-flash` on 2026-10-08 and points new work at `gemini-3.8-flash`; `gemini-3.6-flash` works but is previous-generation. Please use `gemini-3.8-flash`, which the rest of the repo uses.
2. `hybrid_search_rag/README.md` line 18 has a trailing space.

Not verified here: RAGLite passing the bare `claude-opus-4-8` id through litellm; if you ran the app, a line saying so in the description would help.
